text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Slipped Capital Femoral Epiphysis (SCFE). The clinical presentation of a limp and localized knee pain in a 7-year-old male, without trauma or fever, is classic for hip pathology referred to the knee; SCFE is the most likely diagnosis given the age and symptoms.
